constraints.name: complete_pairing
constraints.description: The 2k universities must be partitioned into exactly k disjoint pairs, with each university belonging to exactly one pair.

constraints.name: distinct_nodes_for_universities
constraints.description: All 2k universities are located in mutually distinct towns (i.e., no two universities share the same town).

constraints.name: unit_edge_weight
constraints.description: Every road has the same length equal to 1, so the distance between two universities is the number of edges on the unique tree path.

constraints.name: maximize_total_pairwise_distance
constraints.description: The objective is to maximize the total sum of distances over the k university pairs.
